note: A15.8 baseline 2026-09-17: FULL via=queue (extract 2/2, literal 2/2, route 1/1, forbid 2/2). This is the LIST shape; `ISubscriber.PublishAsync` / `SubscribeAsync` (Redis pub/sub) is a different path and deserves its own variant fixture. The CACHE data_source:redis nodes are correct, not phantoms. Keyed on QUEUE_* + QUEUE_FLOWS like every A15.7 messaging cell, including the eventbus-first mechanisms (sqs_sns, azure_sb, redis, mqtt), so TypeScript/Java/C# read on the same scale as Python/Go and an EVENT_* key cannot flip to `none` when A2.9 moves broker pub/sub out of eventbus.rs. `via` still records the eventbus path when that is what fired.
